title: koeleria cristata var. elegantula
intro: Koeleria cristata var. elegantula, commonly known as Elegant Hair Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and alleviating symptoms of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Elegant Hair Grass are attributed to its ability to relax the smooth muscles, reduce spasms, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria cristata var. elegantula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
